verdict.rationale: Temporal has no built-in connected-app triggers. Workflows can still be started from application code: the Temporal Client lets your apps start Workflow Executions and send Signals, so event-driven triggering is possible only by writing custom integration code. Temporal states it is Workflows-as-Code rather than a no-code engine, and its documented native trigger is time-based Schedules. Missing for 10: pre-built app connectors or event triggers (new record, message, email, form submission), an ops-user (non-developer) way to configure triggers, and webhook/event-ingestion documentation.
